title: LIT, stop at 50% of the sweep-extreme distance, flat $800
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Half the stop doubles the stop-outs of trades that later work; H2 loses money. 2026 H1 (pick) n=80 3.12/wk win 15.0% PF 3.1 net +58,978 ($9,676/mo) DD -8,436 median stop 22.12 pts, 16.0 micros, $767 at risk; eval 2wk 50.0/27.3 1mo 57.0/30.5 pass rate 65.2% median 4.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=40 2.56/wk win 10.0% PF 0.77 net -4,311 ($-1,161/mo) DD -9,276 median stop 25.814999999999998 pts, 14.0 micros, $770 at risk; eval 2wk 14.1/48.7 1mo 14.1/61.5 pass rate 16.2% median 4.0; 2021-25 reference only n=510 2.38/wk win 7.8% PF 0.8 net -39,869 ($-781/mo) DD -62,197 median stop 19.060000000000002 pts, 20.0 micros, $778 at risk; eval 2wk 16.0/49.5 1mo 18.0/76.8 pass rate 18.2% median 5.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
